title: S4Blind.lean gated: the S4 blind-spot face is NAMED and its own-floor form is machine-closed-off (blindSpot predicate on the pole-mass-invisible scale 2d/t^2 < 6.5e-5; squeezeImpossibleOnBlind proves the BwireO+Mr+Mf < mown squeeze impossible at any blind-spot pair; the 25-series boundary pins arithmetic-gated; s4OpenFace names the remaining open mathematics)
body: FORMAL MILESTONE (no RH claim).  FILE: formal/RhAttack/S4Blind.lean (127 lines, namespace S4Bl, imports P12Uniform + S4Gap; builds GREEN, the full tree re-verified after).  WHAT IT IS: the P12 header has named the S4 blind spot as the REMAINING OPEN MATHEMATICS of the prize (the small-d large-t own-regime pairs where the pole-mass instrument is invisible at 2d/t^2 <~ 6.5e-5 and the pin is invisible at 4kd/t^2 <~ floor, measured only at the instrument boundaries).  This module makes that naming a first-class formal object.  (i) blindSpot (t d) : Prop = 1000 <= t and 0 < d <= 1/2 and 2 d / t^2 < 6.5e-5 (the 25a instrument scale, the BSY measure I(1e7) = +1.29e-6; the 25n pin-invisibility restriction is header-recorded, its k-count is data-side).  (ii) squeezeImpossibleOnBlind: the S4 squeeze in the CONCRETE own-height wiring (BwireO + Mr + Mf < S4O.mown) is PROVEN impossible at any blind-spot pair for nonnegative Mr, Mf - S4G.s4c_squeeze_impossible (the 25p gap certificate: mown <= (16001/15984)/t^2 < (1/2)(13t/8)^(-1/2) <= (1/2) n^(-1/2) <= p8_B t n = BwireO) applied to the strip part of the predicate.  Honest reading: the OWN-FLOOR form of the blind-spot face is now machine-closed-off in Lean - the residual S4 content on the blind spot lives in the WIRING / FLOOR choice off the own mass (any wiring flo >= mown that still squeezes), which is the named open face.  (iii) MEASURED pins (25-series; the content is the measurement, the gates are arithmetic): tstarHold = 690349.0568 (the window-regime squeeze-hold boundary, 25l/25n sweep scripts/rh/day023_s4_sweep.py + out_day023_s4_sweep.txt), deltaWin1e3 = -0.953692 and deltaWin1e7 = +5374.37 (the deficit crossing), closeWitnessT = 5004.7343 with certified margin 143.341847457 (25c, dps-30), bsyI1e7 = 1.29e-6 (25a); pinGates machine-checks the band order 1e3 < tstarHold < 1e7, the negative-to-positive crossing, the witness inside the sound region [1e3, 1e6], and positivity.  (iv) s4OpenFace (flo) : Prop = for all blind-spot pairs, BwireO + 0 + 0 < flo(t,d) and mown(t,d) <= flo(t,d) - the DECLARED (not proven) open residue, exactly the P12 header statement now a named object.  STATUS after: the remaining open content of the program is exactly the named faces - the hs1 pin family (S1Face/S1Ge), the hs3 wire pin, hWin (S4 window-pin shape), the C-channel row M values (s34f/s34j in flight on the far rows), THIS blind-spot S4 face (s4OpenFace), and the external review of B6.  Card added (95 cards, 695 body lines); _MAP.md S4 block updated; PATHWAY section 2 updated (the 'remaining' line now enumerates the named faces instead of the completed C channel).  NOVELTY SCOPE: naming + machine-closure of a face's own-floor form; the impossibility itself is the 25p certificate restated on the blind-spot predicate.  No RH claim.
